title: Credo Cardinale (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Credo Cardinale. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0206), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. II. Masses, Part 2, 2018); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
